slides.headline: Atlantic Crossing Shatters Speed Records
slides.dateline: NEW YORK & PARIS  //  ARCHIVE EDITION NO. 42
columns: AVIATION RECORD // Twin-engine endurance crossings cut maritime transit schedules from seven days to fourteen hours across North Atlantic corridors.
NAVIGATION // Celestial sextant fixes combined with directional radio beacons enabled continuous all-weather corridor tracking.
INDUSTRIAL SCALE // Precision optical telemetry and pressurized aluminum airframes ushered in modern global passenger flight.
